title: Rendering and font tolerance
rule: Reference checks use 0.1 percent of pixels per slide, 1 percent per item, and no line-count change. Missing fonts are reported and never silently substituted. A font row has a file hash and a license, or an explicit unresolved entry. Viewports are the 1470 by 923 studio frame and 320 CSS px for access and read-only deck viewing. Visual PowerPoint comparisons stay unproven until P09 X01.
alternatives: Substitute a metric-compatible font without recording it.
Treat a local LibreOffice render as the PowerPoint pass.
Allow line-count changes inside the pixel budget.
